acceptance_criteria.criterion: `resolveProjectStore()` catch block logs caught errors to stderr
Log output includes sufficient context (error message, slug/repo parameters) for operator diagnostics
No change to the function's return value or error-handling behavior (logging is additive only)

summary: Added diagnostic logging to the resolveProjectStore() catch block in gui/api.ts. Changed bare `catch {}` to `catch (err) {}`, extracted the error message, and emitted a process.stderr.write call with slug, optional repo name, and the error message. Follows the existing `[handleGetInsights]` stderr logging pattern in the same file. TypeScript compiles cleanly (tsc --noEmit exits 0). Pre-existing dialogue-qa.test.ts failures on this branch are unrelated to this change (confirmed by stash test).

comments.note: The first catch block in resolveProjectStore() (handling NOT_FOUND/AMBIGUOUS from resolveProjectDir) also rethrows unexpected errors without logging them. Consider adding a stderr log before the `throw err` on line 187 so operator-visible context is preserved for unexpected resolveProjectDir failures, not just .meta.json read failures.
The log prefix `[resolveProjectStore]` follows the established pattern used by `[handleGetInsights]` in the same file. This is consistent and good — no action required.

summary: All 3 acceptance criteria verified. TypeScript build passes (tsc --noEmit exit 0). The new catch block in resolveProjectStore() logs correctly to stderr: live output confirmed during test run — `[resolveProjectStore] Failed to read metadata for slug=... repo=...: ENOENT...`. Return/error-handling behavior is unchanged (notFound() still called after logging). 170 api.test.ts tests pass; 1075 of 1092 broader GUI tests pass. The 17 failures are all pre-existing dialogue-qa.test.ts regressions on this branch, unrelated to this change.

comments.note: Non-Error throw safety: `String(err)` fallback in `errMsg` extraction correctly handles non-Error thrown values — no issues found.
The 17 dialogue-qa.test.ts failures are pre-existing on branch feature-orchestrator-resume and confirmed unrelated to mcp-server/gui/api.ts changes in this WP. These should be tracked separately.

summary: Reviewed the additive stderr logging change in resolveProjectStore() second catch block (mcp-server/gui/api.ts, lines 190–202). The implementation is clean, minimal, and correctly scoped. Pattern (bracketed prefix, errMsg extraction, process.stderr.write) is fully consistent with the established convention in the same file (handleGetInsights, handleResetProject, handleGetProjectHealth). No behavioral change — notFound() still called, return value unchanged, TypeScript compiles cleanly. All three acceptance criteria are met. PASS — no blocking issues found.

comments.note: Minor convention divergence: the new errMsg uses `err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)` (extracts .message only for Error instances), while other stderr log sites in the same file use `String(err)` directly (which would produce 'Error: <message>'). Both are valid; .message is actually cleaner for one-line diagnostic output. Leaving as-is — the current implementation is readable and consistent with its immediate context.

The first catch block (line 180–187) rethrows unexpected resolveProjectDir failures without logging them. Adding a stderr write before `throw err` would give operators visibility into those failure paths too. Out of scope for this WP but worth tracking as a follow-up. Already noted by Developer in implementation pipeline.

[documentation-forward] Consider adding a JSDoc note or inline comment to resolveProjectStore() documenting that the second catch block logs to stderr before returning a NOT_FOUND, so future maintainers understand the diagnostic behaviour and don't silently remove it.

summary: Added a JSDoc @remarks block to resolveProjectStore() in mcp-server/gui/api.ts documenting the stderr diagnostic logging behavior in the second catch block. The note explains what triggers the log (metadata read failures), what context the log line includes (slug, optional repo name, error message), that the function's externally-visible behavior is unchanged, and includes a preservation warning advising future maintainers not to remove the stderr.write call. This addresses the documentation-forward item tagged by the Reviewer. All three acceptance criteria were already met by the implementation pipeline; this pipeline adds the maintainability documentation layer.

comments.note: Addressed the documentation-forward item from code-review: added a @remarks JSDoc block on resolveProjectStore() that documents the stderr logging behavior in the second catch block, including what is logged, why it exists, and a preservation warning for future maintainers.
